name: 55068 · Rosemount, MN
findings: ZIP 55068 (Rosemount) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55068 (Rosemount) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
